text:
alexa: new user running the Node quickstart keeps getting a 429 followed by a 'billing required' prompt in the UI. they ran the sample which spawns 8 parallel requests to simulate load and saw intermittent success then failures.

alexa: command they ran: `node quickstart-batch.js --workers=8` (from our sample repo). logs:
```
2026-03-10T12:05:01Z INFO request start id=1
2026-03-10T12:05:01Z ERROR request id=3 status=429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-10T12:05:02Z INFO sdk retrying (attempt 1) id=3
2026-03-10T12:05:03Z ERROR request id=5 status=429 Too Many Requests
...
```
UI: onboarding-bot shows banner: "Billing required to continue" after repeated failures which confused user.

jamal: looks like they hit the trial concurrency/quota limit. quickstart sample's default workers=8 is too aggressive for trial accounts. the onboarding banner is triggered by repeated 4xx/5xx and currently uses a generic message so it misleads users into thinking billing is the root cause.

support-bot: Confirmed workspace "fast-nova" is on trial and has a concurrent request cap of 3. several requests above that will be 429.

alexa: suggested fixes:
- update sample repo default to workers=2 and add a comment about trial concurrency limits.
- SDK improvement: for 429 return a clear message: "Rate limited: concurrency or quota exceeded. If you are on a trial, reduce parallel requests or upgrade." Link to doc.
- Onboarding UX: change banner text to "Request rate or quota hit. Billing may be needed for higher concurrency; try reducing parallelism to continue."

jamal: I'll open DOCS-900 (quickstart concurrency notes) and SDK-401 (better 429 error text). also small PR to sample to lower default workers.

alexa: user was able to finish onboarding after running with workers=2 on a personal laptop. i'll reply with the workaround and close the support case once docs/PRs are merged.

devex-bot: created tickets DOCS-900, SDK-401.

alexa: thanks all :raised_hands:
